Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p> <p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>About the Role</em></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><em>Foremost a software engineer</em></strong><em>.</em> You exemplify high code quality and guide others, and have at least <strong>5 years</strong> of industry experience as a data engineer or similar role. <ul> <li>You are experienced in creating automated testing, applying design patterns, and other engineering best practices.</li> <li>You are an expert in Python and possess fluency in SQL and have developed maintainable data pipelines with each.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong><em>Hands-on with architecting solutions.&nbsp;</em></strong>You have designed several data pipelines from start to finish. Choosing appropriate technologies, building, testing and rollout.</li> <li><strong><em>Experience with aychronous systems. </em></strong>You are comfortable identifying and applying APIs, streaming, multithreading, and other asynchronous approaches to the right problems. You understand how to monitor and maintain these systems.</li> <li><strong><em>Product mindset.&nbsp;</em></strong>You think about the business impact of your work, and can use high-level goals to prioritize work.</li> <li><strong><em>Communication Extraordinaire.</em></strong> You excel at communicating to both technical and non-technical people, with an ability to explain complex concepts simply.</li> <li><strong><em>ML/AI–aware. </em></strong>You have working knowledge of how ML/AI applications are deployed and monitored, and you’re motivated to use this awareness to advance data-driven initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Here's How You Will Make an Impact</em></strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Collaborate with product managers, data analysts, and machine learning engineers to
